bugs.title: Armed LED stays LOW after solenoid pulse ends
bugs.description: The pulse-end branch at lines 79-84 does call setArmedLed(true), but the measured evidence shows D11 remained not-HIGH for the full 2501 ms pulse window plus the 120 ms grace, i.e. the LED was LOW while D8 was already LOW. The idle-state LED is only restored inside that same branch (line 83), so any path where pulsing is cleared without re-driving the LED leaves D11 stuck LOW; the heartbeat at lines 34-40 and loop never re-assert the armed state, so the LED does not follow D8 back to idle. D11 was in the wrong state for 6573 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 825 ms: D11 was not HIGH for 2501 ms while required (grace 120 ms).
